queries.name: hcm_identity_objects
queries.sql:
SELECT
    s.name AS schema_name,
    o.name AS object_name,
    o.type_desc
FROM sys.objects o
JOIN sys.schemas s
  ON s.schema_id = o.schema_id
WHERE s.name = 'dbo'
  AND o.name IN (
      'Gobierno_Persona',
      'Gobierno_PersonaVinculo',
      'Gobierno_PersonaEmpresaRol',
      'Gobierno_RolCorporativoCatalogo',
      'RH_Colaboradores_Expediente',
      'RH_Candidatos'
  )
ORDER BY o.name;

queries.name: hcm_identity_columns
queries.sql:
SELECT
    t.name AS table_name,
    c.column_id,
    c.name AS column_name,
    ty.name AS data_type,
    c.max_length,
    c.is_nullable,
    c.is_identity,
    c.is_computed
FROM sys.tables t
JOIN sys.columns c
  ON c.object_id = t.object_id
JOIN sys.types ty
  ON ty.user_type_id = c.user_type_id
WHERE t.name IN (
    'Gobierno_Persona',
    'Gobierno_PersonaVinculo',
    'Gobierno_PersonaEmpresaRol',
    'Gobierno_RolCorporativoCatalogo',
    'RH_Colaboradores_Expediente',
    'RH_Candidatos'
)
ORDER BY t.name, c.column_id;

queries.name: hcm_identity_foreign_keys
queries.sql:
SELECT
    OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) AS parent_table,
    pc.name AS parent_column,
    OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) AS referenced_table,
    rc.name AS referenced_column,
    fk.name AS foreign_key_name
FROM sys.foreign_keys fk
JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc
  ON fkc.constraint_object_id = fk.object_id
JOIN sys.columns pc
  ON pc.object_id = fk.parent_object_id
 AND pc.column_id = fkc.parent_column_id
JOIN sys.columns rc
  ON rc.object_id = fk.referenced_object_id
 AND rc.column_id = fkc.referenced_column_id
WHERE OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) IN (
    'Gobierno_Persona',
    'Gobierno_PersonaVinculo',
    'Gobierno_PersonaEmpresaRol',
    'RH_Colaboradores_Expediente',
    'RH_Candidatos'
)
ORDER BY parent_table, foreign_key_name;

queries.name: rh_personaid_presence
queries.sql:
SELECT
    t.name AS table_name,
    c.name AS column_name,
    ty.name AS data_type,
    c.is_nullable
FROM sys.tables t
JOIN sys.columns c
  ON c.object_id = t.object_id
JOIN sys.types ty
  ON ty.user_type_id = c.user_type_id
WHERE t.name IN (
    'RH_Colaboradores_Expediente',
    'RH_Candidatos'
)
AND (
    c.name LIKE '%PersonaID%'
    OR c.name LIKE '%Gobierno%'
)
ORDER BY t.name, c.column_id;

queries.name: identity_table_rowcounts
queries.sql:
SELECT
    t.name AS table_name,
    SUM(p.rows) AS row_count
FROM sys.tables t
JOIN sys.partitions p
  ON p.object_id = t.object_id
 AND p.index_id IN (0,1)
WHERE t.name IN (
    'Gobierno_Persona',
    'Gobierno_PersonaVinculo',
    'Gobierno_PersonaEmpresaRol',
    'Gobierno_RolCorporativoCatalogo',
    'RH_Colaboradores_Expediente',
    'RH_Candidatos'
)
GROUP BY t.name
ORDER BY t.name;

queries.name: gobierno_persona_duplicate_curp
queries.sql:
SELECT
    CURP,
    COUNT(*) AS cantidad
FROM dbo.Gobierno_Persona
WHERE CURP IS NOT NULL
  AND LTRIM(RTRIM(CURP)) <> ''
GROUP BY CURP
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY cantidad DESC, CURP;

queries.name: rh_colaborador_identity_quality
queries.sql:
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CURP IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(CURP))='' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sin_curp,
    SUM(CASE WHEN RFC IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(RFC))='' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sin_rfc,
    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN (CURP IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(CURP))='')
             AND (RFC IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(RFC))='')
            THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS sin_curp_y_rfc
FROM dbo.RH_Colaboradores_Expediente;

queries.name: rh_colaborador_gobierno_match_curp
queries.sql:
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS matches_curp
FROM dbo.RH_Colaboradores_Expediente c
JOIN dbo.Gobierno_Persona p
  ON p.CURP = c.CURP
WHERE c.CURP IS NOT NULL
  AND LTRIM(RTRIM(c.CURP)) <> '';

queries.name: rh_colaborador_gobierno_match_rfc_only
queries.sql:
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS matches_rfc_only
FROM dbo.RH_Colaboradores_Expediente c
JOIN dbo.Gobierno_Persona p
  ON p.RFC = c.RFC
WHERE c.RFC IS NOT NULL
  AND LTRIM(RTRIM(c.RFC)) <> ''
  AND (
      c.CURP IS NULL
      OR LTRIM(RTRIM(c.CURP))=''
      OR p.CURP IS NULL
      OR p.CURP <> c.CURP
  );

queries.name: rh_colaborador_rfc_ambiguous_matches
queries.sql:
SELECT
    c.RFC,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.PersonaID) AS personas_coincidentes
FROM dbo.RH_Colaboradores_Expediente c
JOIN dbo.Gobierno_Persona p
  ON p.RFC = c.RFC
WHERE c.RFC IS NOT NULL
  AND LTRIM(RTRIM(c.RFC)) <> ''
GROUP BY c.RFC
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.PersonaID) > 1
ORDER BY personas_coincidentes DESC, c.RFC;

queries.name: gobierno_roles_catalogo_hcm_candidates
queries.sql:
SELECT
    RolCorporativoID,
    Codigo,
    Nombre,
    RequiereParticipacion,
    RequiereFacultades,
    Activo
FROM dbo.Gobierno_RolCorporativoCatalogo
WHERE UPPER(Codigo) LIKE '%COLAB%'
   OR UPPER(Codigo) LIKE '%EMPLE%'
   OR UPPER(Codigo) LIKE '%CANDID%'
   OR UPPER(Nombre) LIKE '%COLAB%'
   OR UPPER(Nombre) LIKE '%EMPLE%'
   OR UPPER(Nombre) LIKE '%CANDID%'
ORDER BY Codigo;

queries.name: gobierno_persona_vinculo_distribution
queries.sql:
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN UsuarioID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS usuarios,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ClienteID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS clientes,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ProveedorID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS proveedores,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ContactoClienteID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contactos_cliente,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ContactoProveedorID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contactos_proveedor,
    COUNT(*) AS total
FROM dbo.Gobierno_PersonaVinculo
WHERE Activo=1;
